# P510: Profile Banner UX Polish — Acceptance Tests

**Purpose:** Testable acceptance criteria for profile banner UX redesign.
**Usage:** Ralph Loop iterates until ALL tests pass (score 100%).
**Source:** features/p510_profile_banner_ux_polish.md
**Generated:** 2026-03-14

---

## Test Scoring

Score = passed_tests / 11 (shown as X/11 or N%)
Total tests: 11
Pass threshold: 11/11 (100% — all tests must pass)

---

## Category 1: Visual Layout (4 tests)

### UAT-1.1: Gradient fallback is visible and branded
**Given:** Profile has no banner image
**When:** Visitor navigates to `/p/:slug`
**Then:** Banner area shows a visible blue-to-indigo-to-purple gradient (not transparent/blank)
**Verify:** Visual inspection via browser or Claude in Chrome screenshot

### UAT-1.2: Avatar is 96px with white ring
**Given:** Any profile page
**When:** Page loads
**Then:** Avatar is 96px circle with a white ring-4 border, overlapping the bottom-left of the banner by ~48px
**Verify:** Browser DevTools inspect element dimensions

### UAT-1.3: Name and role beside avatar
**Given:** Any profile page
**When:** Page loads
**Then:** Name + ear count appear inline to the right of the avatar (on the overlap row). Role appears below name, also beside the avatar. Name is NOT stacked below the avatar.
**Verify:** Visual inspection — compare to the ASCII diagram in the spec

### UAT-1.4: Banner height is responsive
**Given:** Any profile page
**When:** Viewed on mobile (375px) vs desktop (1280px)
**Then:** Banner area is approximately 120px on mobile, 160px on desktop
**Verify:** Chrome DevTools responsive mode or resize

---

## Category 2: Controls Interaction (4 tests)

### UAT-2.1: Controls hidden behind pencil icon (owner only)
**Given:** Owner views their own profile
**When:** Page loads
**Then:** A small pencil icon is visible at top-right of the banner. No pill buttons, no search input visible.
**Verify:** Visual inspection as owner

### UAT-2.2: Visitor and anonymous users see no controls
**Given:** Visitor or anonymous user views a profile
**When:** Page loads
**Then:** No pencil icon, no controls of any kind visible in the banner area
**Verify:** Navigate to profile while not logged in and while logged in as a different user

### UAT-2.3: Dropdown opens with correct items
**Given:** Owner views their profile with a banner image
**When:** Owner clicks the pencil icon
**Then:** Dropdown shows "New banner", "Describe your banner...", and "Remove banner". If no banner exists, "Remove" is hidden.
**Verify:** Click pencil icon, inspect menu items

### UAT-2.4: Dropdown closes correctly
**Given:** Dropdown is open
**When:** Owner presses Escape OR clicks outside the dropdown
**Then:** Dropdown closes, focus returns to pencil icon
**Verify:** Keyboard Escape and click-away test

---

## Category 3: Search Input Gating (2 tests)

### UAT-3.1: Search input NOT shown on page load
**Given:** Owner views their profile
**When:** Page loads (including after a failed banner generation)
**Then:** No search input is visible. The `showSearch` bug from P504 is fixed.
**Verify:** Load page as owner, confirm no text input in banner area

### UAT-3.2: Search input only via dropdown
**Given:** Owner views their profile
**When:** Owner clicks pencil > "Describe your banner..."
**Then:** Search input appears, auto-focused, with placeholder "Describe your banner"
**Verify:** Open dropdown, click describe, verify input appears

---

## Category 4: Regression (1 test)

### UAT-4.1: Existing P504 tests still pass
**Given:** P510 changes are applied
**When:** Run `npx playwright test e2e/p504-banners.spec.ts e2e/p504-smoke.spec.ts e2e/a11y/p504-banner-accessibility.spec.ts`
**Then:** All existing P504 tests pass. Story and point banner behavior is unchanged.
**Verify:** Run test suite, confirm 0 failures
